pick.label: Pick
pick.title: Choosing a key
pick.summary: Search by title, check the platform, region and type on every card, choose the edition, read the requirements and add the key to your cart.
captions: Search by title or browse by platform
Every card shows platform, region and type
Choose the edition and check the requirements
pick.tipLabel: Steam · Global · Base game. Global means no regional lock.
pick.tipRequirements: Needs a Steam account. Languages: EN, DE, FR, ES. Delivered to your account.

pay.label: Pay
pay.title: Paying on the hosted page
pay.summary: You confirm the order and the delivery terms, enter your card details on the payment provider's hosted page, and your bank confirms the payment with 3-D Secure. Keyrook receives the confirmation, never your card number.
pay.hostedUrl: secure payment page · your payment provider
captions: Confirm the order and the delivery terms
Card details go into the payment provider's hosted page
Your bank confirms it's you with 3-D Secure
We receive the payment confirmation, never your card number
pay.regionCheck: I've checked the platform and region of each key.
pay.terms: I have read and agree to the Terms and Conditions
pay.hostedNote: Illustration of a payment provider's hosted page. The real page belongs to the provider.
pay.bankWaiting: Approve this payment in your banking app
pay.bankNote: 3-D Secure check between you and your bank
pay.notReceived: Card number: stays with the payment provider
pay.tipConfirmation: Keyrook receives: payment confirmed, amount, order number. The card number stays with the payment provider.

decrypt.label: Decrypt
decrypt.title: Revealing the key
decrypt.summary: After payment is confirmed, the key is issued to your account, stays masked until you reveal it, and can be copied or taken straight to the platform's redeem page.
captions: Payment confirmed: your key is issued to your account
It stays masked and encrypted until you reveal it
Copy it, or open the platform's redeem page
decrypt.tipPlate: Stored encrypted. Decrypted only when you choose Reveal.
decrypt.tipPlatePlain: Kept in your account. Shown only when you choose Reveal.
decrypt.tipRedeem: Opens Steam's own redeem page in a new tab
decrypt.heading: Keys

redeem.label: Redeem
redeem.title: Redeeming on the platform
redeem.summary: You redeem the key in the platform's own app or page: open the redeem option from its menu, paste the key and confirm. The product is added to your library.
captions: The game is added to your library
redeem.agree: I agree to the terms of the subscriber agreement
redeem.illustration: Neutral illustration of a launcher window. Menu names come from the platform's help pages.

support.label: Support
support.title: Getting help with a key
support.summary: If a key doesn't work, you report it from the order. We check it and reply {replyTime}; a faulty key is replaced, or refunded if no replacement is available.
captions: Key not working? Report it from the order
A faulty key is replaced, or refunded
support.dialogTitle: Report a key that doesn't work
support.note: Steam says this key was already used.
support.tipOutcome: Sample outcome. A key that doesn't work through no fault of yours is replaced, or refunded if no replacement is available.
